automatons.title: Automatons
automatons.description: The Automatons are a machine faction hostile to Super Earth. They field heavily armored infantry, walkers, tanks, and industrial war machines across the Galactic War.

terminids.title: Terminids
terminids.description: The Terminids are a rapidly reproducing insectoid species that threaten Super Earth-controlled worlds and are tied closely to the production of Element 710.

illuminate.title: Illuminate
illuminate.description: The Illuminate are an advanced alien civilization known for highly sophisticated technology, energy weapons, teleportation, and psionic capabilities.

super-earth.title: Super Earth
super-earth.description: Super Earth is the center of Managed Democracy and the governing power behind the Helldivers, SEAF, and humanity's expansion throughout the galaxy.
